请问去博物馆这条路怎么走？(Qǐngwèn qù bówùguǎn zhè tiáo lù zěnme zǒu?) — Excuse me, how do I get to the museum along this road?
从我家到公司不算太远。(Cóng wǒ jiā dào gōngsī bú suàn tài yuǎn.) — From my home to the company is not too far.
这家咖啡馆离学校很近。(Zhè jiā kāfēiguǎn lí xuéxiào hěn jìn.) — This café is very close to school.
请问到天安门广场怎么走？(Qǐngwèn dào Tiān'ānmén Guǎngchǎng zěnme zǒu?) — Excuse me, how do I get to Tiananmen Square?
今天天气真好，晴空万里。(Jīntiān tiānqì zhēn hǎo, qíngkōng wànlǐ.) — The weather today is really great, completely clear skies.
你觉得这家餐馆怎么样？(Nǐ juéde zhè jiā cānguǎn zěnmeyàng?) — How do you like this restaurant?
夏天这里非常热。(Xiàtiān zhèlǐ fēicháng rè.) — In summer it is very hot here.
今天刮风，有点儿冷。(Jīntiān guāfēng, yǒudiǎnr lěng.) — It's windy today and a bit cold.
春天的下午很暖和。(Chūntiān de xiàwǔ hěn nuǎnhuo.) — Spring afternoons are warm and pleasant.
下过雨后天气很凉快。(Xià guò yǔ hòu tiānqì hěn liángkuai.) — After the rain the weather is pleasantly cool.
出门记得带伞，外面要下雨了。(Chūmén jìde dài sǎn, wàimiàn yào xiàyǔ le.) — Remember to bring an umbrella, it is going to rain outside.
冬天北方经常下雪。(Dōngtiān běifāng jīngcháng xiàxuě.) — It often snows in the north during winter.
明天是个晴天，适合去郊游。(Míngtiān shì gè qíngtiān, shìhé qù jiāoyóu.) — Tomorrow will be a sunny day, perfect for an outing.
今天一直是阴天，没有出太阳。(Jīntiān yìzhí shì yīntiān, méiyǒu chū tàiyáng.) — Today has been overcast all day, no sun came out.
外面正在刮风，天气很凉。(Wàimiàn zhèngzài guāfēng, tiānqì hěn liáng.) — The wind is blowing outside; the weather is cool.
太阳从东边升起来了。(Tàiyáng cóng dōngbian shēng qǐlái le.) — The sun rose from the east.
中秋节的月亮又圆又亮。(Zhōngqiūjié de yuèliang yòu yuán yòu liàng.) — The Mid-Autumn moon is both round and bright.
夜空中闪烁着无数的星星。(Yèkōng zhōng shǎnshuò zhe wúshù de xīngxing.) — Countless stars twinkle in the night sky.
春天百花盛开，景色非常美。(Chūntiān bǎihuā shèngkāi, jǐngsè fēicháng měi.) — In spring all flowers bloom and scenery is beautiful.
夏天大家喜欢去海边游泳。(Xiàtiān dàjiā xǐhuan qù hǎibiān yóuyǒng.) — In summer everyone likes going to the beach to swim.
北京的秋天是一年中最美的季节。(Běijīng de qiūtiān shì yì nián zhōng zuì měi de jìjié.) — Beijing's autumn is the prettiest season of the year.
冬天出门要戴帽子和围巾。(Dōngtiān chūmén yào dài màozi hé wéijīn.) — Wear a hat and scarf when going out in winter.
周末我们一起去爬山吧。(Zhōumò wǒmen yìqǐ qù pá shān ba.) — Let's go climb mountains together this weekend.
院子里种着两棵大树。(Yuànzi lǐ zhòng zhe liǎng kē dà shù.) — Two large trees are planted in the courtyard.
公园里的红花开得真鲜艳。(Gōngyuán lǐ de hóng huā kāi de zhēn xiānyàn.) — The red flowers in the park bloom vividly.
请不要踩踏草坪。(Qǐng bú yào cǎità cǎopíng.) — Please do not trample on the grass.
一条清清的小河穿过村庄。(Yì tiáo qīngqīng de xiǎo hé chuānguò cūnzhuāng.) — A clear small river flows through the village.
海边的日落景色非常迷人。(Hǎibiān de rìluò jǐngsè fēicháng mírén.) — The sunset view by the seaside is charming.

meaning: to want / to miss / to think
example: 我想学习流利的普通话。(Wǒ xiǎng xuéxí liúlì de pǔtōnghuà.) — I want to learn fluent Mandarin.
明天我要参加一场考试。(Míngtiān wǒ yào cānjiā yì chǎng kǎoshì.) — Tomorrow I need to take an exam.

meaning: can / to know how to / will
example: 你会说中文和法语吗？(Nǐ huì shuō zhōngwén hé fǎyǔ ma?) — Can you speak Chinese and French?

meaning: can / to be able to / may
example: 你能帮我拿一下行李吗？(Nǐ néng bāng wǒ ná yíxià xíngli ma?) — Can you help me carry the luggage?
请问我可以坐这里吗？(Qǐngwèn wǒ kěyǐ zuò zhèlǐ ma?) — Excuse me, may I sit here?

meaning: to like / to be fond of
example: 我非常喜欢看书和跑步。(Wǒ fēicháng xǐhuan kànshū hé pǎobù.) — I like reading and running very much.
我们深爱着我们的家人。(Wǒmen shēn'ài zhe wǒmen de jiārén.) — We deeply love our family.

meaning: to feel / to think / to consider
example: 我觉得这套卡片很有帮助。(Wǒ juéde zhè tào kǎpiàn hěn yǒu bāngzhù.) — I think this flashcard set is very helpful.
听到这个好消息大家都很高兴。(Tīngdào zhè gè hǎo xiāoxi dàjiā dōu hěn gāoxìng.) — Everyone is happy hearing this good news.
祝大家新年快乐，万事如意！(Zhù dàjiā xīnnián kuàilè, wànshì rúyì!) — Wish everyone a Happy New Year and all the best!
今天工作了一整天，感觉很累。(Jīntiān gōngzuò le yì zhěng tiān, gǎnjué hěn lèi.) — Worked all day today, feeling very tired.
我肚子有点饿了，去吃点东西吧。(Wǒ dùzi yǒudiǎn è le, qù chī diǎn dōngxi ba.) — I'm feeling a bit hungry, let's go eat something.
打完球以后大家都很渴。(Dǎ wán qiú yǐhòu dàjiā dōu hěn kě.) — After playing ball, everyone was very thirsty.
今天天气凉爽，感觉很舒服。(Jīntiān tiānqì liángshuǎng, gǎnjué hěn shūfu.) — Cool weather today, feels very comfortable.

meaning: to fall ill / to get sick
example: 天气变冷要注意保暖，别生病了。(Tiānqì biàn lěng yào zhùyì bǎonuǎn, bié shēngbìng le.) — Keep warm as weather turns cold, don't get sick.
我嗓子有点疼。(Wǒ sǎngzi yǒudiǎn téng.) — My throat is a little sore.

meaning: cold / flu / to catch a cold
example: 他感冒了，需要多喝热水。(Tā gǎnmào le, xūyào duō hē rè shuǐ.) — He caught a cold and needs to drink more hot water.
谢谢你耐心的帮助。(Xièxie nǐ nàixīn de bāngzhù.) — Thank you for your patient help.
这句话我听懂了。(Zhè jù huà wǒ tīng dǒng le.) — I understood this sentence.
你明白这个语法规则了吗？(Nǐ míngbai zhè gè yǔfǎ guīzé le ma?) — Do you understand this grammar rule?
你知道去机场的路怎么走吗？(Nǐ zhīdào qù jīchǎng de lù zěnme zǒu ma?) — Do you know the route to the airport?
你在中国认识很多新朋友吗？(Nǐ zài Zhōngguó rènshi hěn duō xīn péngyou ma?) — Did you get to know many new friends in China?
坚持每天学习中文。(Jiānchí měitiān xuéxí zhōngwén.) — Persevere in studying Chinese every day.
希望你学习进步，一切顺利！(Xīwàng nǐ xuéxí jìnbù, yíqiè shùnlì!) — Hope you make good study progress and all goes smoothly!

meaning: to wish / to express good wishes
example: 祝你旅途愉快！(Zhù nǐ lǚtú yúkuài!) — Wish you a pleasant journey!
《创世记》记载了上帝创造天地万物的故事。(《Chuàngshìjì》 jìzǎi le Shàngdì chuàngzào tiāndì wànwù de gùshì.) — Genesis records the story of God creating heaven, earth, and all things.
《出埃及记》讲述了摩西带领以色列人出埃及的历史。(《Chū'āijíjì》 jiǎngshù le Mōxī dàilǐng Yǐsèliè rén chū Āijí de lìshǐ.) — Exodus recounts the history of Moses leading the Israelites out of Egypt.
《利未记》阐述了律法、圣洁与敬拜礼仪。(《Lìwèijì》 chǎnshù le lǜfǎ, shèngjié yǔ jìngbài lǐyí.) — Leviticus expounds on the law, holiness, and worship rituals.
《民数记》记载了在旷野中的人口普查与行军历程。(《Mínshùjì》 jìzǎi le zài kuàngyě zhōng de rénkǒu pǔchá yǔ xíngjūn lìchéng.) — Numbers records the census in the wilderness and the marching journey.
《申命记》重申了上帝的诫命与摩西临终前的嘱托。(《Shēnmìngjì》 chóngshēn le Shàngdì de jièmìng yǔ Mōxī línzhōng qián de zhǔtuō.) — Deuteronomy reiterates God's commandments and Moses' final exhortations.
《约书亚记》讲述了以色列人进入应许之地的征程。(《Yuēshūyàjì》 jiǎngshù le Yǐsèliè rén jìnrù yīngxǔ zhī dì de zhēngchéng.) — Joshua tells the journey of the Israelites entering the Promised Land.
《士师记》记载了士师时代的信实与拯救。(《Shìshījì》 jìzǎi le shìshī shídài de xìnshí yǔ zhěngjiù.) — Judges records faithfulness and deliverance during the era of judges.
《路得记》展现了一段关于爱与忠诚的动人故事。(《Lùdéjì》 zhǎnxiàn le yí duàn guānyú ài yǔ zhōngchéng de dòngrén gùshì.) — Ruth presents a touching story about love, loyalty, and redemption.
《撒母耳记上》记载了先知撒母耳、扫罗与大卫的生平。(《Sāmǔ'ěrjì Shàng》 jìzǎi le xiānzhī Sāmǔ'ěr, Sǎoluó yǔ Dàwèi de shēngpíng.) — 1 Samuel records the lives of Prophet Samuel, Saul, and David.
《撒母耳记下》主要记录了大卫作为以色列君王的统治。(《Sāmǔ'ěrjì Xià》 zhǔyào jìlù le Dàwèi zuòwéi Yǐsèliè jūnwáng de tǒngzhì.) — 2 Samuel primarily records David's reign as king of Israel.
《列王纪上》记载了所罗门的智慧与圣殿的建造。(《Lièwángjì Shàng》 jìzǎi le Suǒluóméng de zhìhuì yǔ Shèngdiàn de jiànzào.) — 1 Kings records Solomon's wisdom and the construction of the Temple.
《列王纪下》记录了南北两国的历史与先知先见的事迹。(《Lièwángjì Xià》 jìlù le nánběi liǎng guó de lìshǐ yǔ xiānzhī xiānjiàn de shìjì.) — 2 Kings records the history of the two kingdoms and the deeds of prophets.
《历代志上》详尽记录了家谱谱系与大卫的敬拜赞美安排。(《Lìdàizhì Shàng》 xiángjìn jìlù le jiāpǔ pǔxì yǔ Dàwèi de jìngbài zànměi ānpái.) — 1 Chronicles details genealogies and David's arrangements for worship.
《历代志下》回顾了历代君王对圣殿的看重与属灵复兴。(《Lìdàizhì Xià》 huígù le lìdài jūnwáng duì Shèngdiàn de kànzhòng yǔ shǔlíng fùxīng.) — 2 Chronicles reviews the kings' devotion to the Temple and spiritual revivals.
《以斯拉记》记载了被掳归回与重建圣殿的历史。(《Yǐsīlājì》 jìzǎi le bèilǔ guīhuí yǔ zhòngjiàn Shèngdiàn de lìshǐ.) — Ezra records the return from exile and the rebuilding of the Temple.
《尼希米记》展现了同心合意重建耶路撒冷城墙的见证。(《Níxīmǐjì》 zhǎnxiàn le tóngxīn héyì zhòngjiàn Yēlùsǎlěng chéngqiáng de jiànzhèng.) — Nehemiah shows the unified effort to rebuild the walls of Jerusalem.
《以斯帖记》讲述了以斯帖王后勇敢拯救同胞的故事。(《Yǐsītiějì》 jiǎngshù le Yǐsītiě wánghòu yǒnggǎn zhěngjiù tóngbāo de gùshì.) — Esther tells the story of Queen Esther bravely saving her people.
《约伯记》深刻探讨了苦难的意义与坚定不移的信心。(《Yuēbójì》 shēnkè tàntǎo le kǔnàn de yìyì yǔ jiāndìng bù yí de xìnxīn.) — Job profoundly explores the meaning of suffering and unwavering faith.
《诗篇》汇集了向神倾心吐意的优美赞美与祷告诗歌。(《Shīpiān》 huìjí le xiàng Shén qīngxīn tǔyì de yōuměi zànměi yǔ dǎogào shīgē.) — Psalms compiles beautiful hymns of praise and heartfelt prayers to God.
《箴言》蕴含了敬畏耶和华与为人处世的宝贵智慧。(《Zhēnyán》 yùnhán le jìngwèi Yēhéhuá yǔ wéirén chǔshì de bǎoguì zhìhuì.) — Proverbs contains precious wisdom on fearing the Lord and living well.
《传道书》探索了日光之下生命的真正意义与归宿。(《Chuándàoshū》 tànsuǒ le rìguāng zhīxià shēngmìng de zhēnzhèng yìyì yǔ guīsù.) — Ecclesiastes explores the true meaning and destination of life under the sun.
《雅歌》用诗意赞美了纯洁美好的真爱与盟约。(《Yǎgē》 yòng shīyì zànměi le chúnjié měihǎo de zhēn’ài yǔ méngyuē.) — Song of Songs poetically praises pure love and sacred covenant.
《以赛亚书》包含了关于弥赛亚降生与救赎的伟大预言。(《Yǐsàiyǎshū》 bāohán le guānyú Mísǎiyà jiàngshēng yǔ jiùshú de wěidà yùyán.) — Isaiah contains grand prophecies of the Messiah's birth and redemption.
《耶利米书》记载了先知充满爱与警戒的忠心宣讲。(《Yēlìmǐshū》 jìzǎi le xiānzhī chōngmǎn ài yǔ jǐngjiè de zhōngxīn xuānjiǎng.) — Jeremiah records the prophet's faithful proclamation filled with love and warnings.
《耶利米哀歌》表达了对圣城的哀伤以及对神怜悯的盼望。(《Yēlìmǐ'āigē》 biǎodá le duì shèngchéng de āishāng yǐjí duì Shén liánmǐn de pànwàng.) — Lamentations expresses grief for the holy city and hope in God's mercies.
《以西结书》记载了枯骨复活等异象与荣耀重建的应许。(《Yǐxījiéshū》 jìzǎi le kūgǔ fùhuó děng yìxiàng yǔ róngyào zhòngjiàn de yīngxǔ.) — Ezekiel records visions like the valley of dry bones and promises of glorious restoration.

《但以理书》展现了在异国他乡坚守信仰与狮子坑中的蒙拯救。(《Dànyǐlǐshū》 zhǎnxiàn le zài yìguó tāxiāng jiānshǒu xìnyǎng yǔ shīzǐkēng zhōng de méng zhěngjiù.) — Daniel shows faithful devotion in exile and miraculous deliverance from the lions' den.
《何西阿书》以婚姻比喻展现神对百姓不离不弃的慈爱。(《Héxī'āshū》 yǐ hūnyīn bǐyù zhǎnxiàn Shén duì bǎixìng bùlí-bùqì de cí'ài.) — Hosea uses marriage as a metaphor for God's relentless, steadfast love.
《约珥书》预言了耶和华的日子与圣灵浇灌的应许。(《Yuē'ěrshū》 yùyán le Yēhéhuá de rìzi yǔ Shènglíng jiāoguàn de yīngxǔ.) — Joel prophesies the Day of the Lord and the promise of the outpouring of the Holy Spirit.
《阿摩司书》强调了公义如江河滚滚流淌的真理。(《Āmósīshū》 qiángdiào le gōngyì rú jiānghé gǔngǔn liútǎng de zhēnlǐ.) — Amos emphasizes letting justice roll down like waters and righteousness like a stream.

《俄巴底亚书》宣告了对骄傲与不义的审判及国度归神的盼望。(《Ébǎdǐyàshū》 xuāngào le duì jiāo'ào yǔ búyì de shěnpàn jí guódù guī Shén de pànwàng.) — Obadiah proclaims judgment upon pride and hope that the kingdom shall be the Lord's.
《约拿书》启示了上帝向尼尼微全城展现的宽广恩典与怜悯。(《Yuēnáshū》 qǐshì le Shàngdì xiàng Níníwēi quánchéng zhǎnxiàn de kuānguǎng ēndiǎn yǔ liánmǐn.) — Jonah reveals God's wide grace and mercy extended toward Nineveh.
《弥迦书》教导人行公义、好怜悯、存谦卑的心与神同行。(《Míjiāshū》 jiàodǎo rén xíng gōngyì, hào liánmǐn, cún qiānbēi de xīn yǔ Shén tóngxíng.) — Micah teaches to act justly, love mercy, and walk humbly with your God.
《那鸿书》宣告了公义的主是患难中的坚固避难所。(《Nàhóngshū》 xuāngào le gōngyì de Zhǔ shì huànnàn zhōng de jiāngù bìnànsuǒ.) — Nahum proclaims that the Lord is good, a refuge in times of trouble.
《哈巴谷书》阐明了惟义人必因信得生的永恒原则。(《Hābǎgǔshū》 chǎnmíng le wéi yìrén bì yīn xìn dé shēng de yǒnghéng yuánzé.) — Habakkuk clarifies that the righteous person shall live by his faith.
《西番雅书》宣告了默然爱你并在你中间欢呼喜乐的应许。(《Xīfānyǎshū》 xuāngào le mòrán ài nǐ bìng zài nǐ zhōngjiān huānhū xǐlè de yīngxǔ.) — Zephaniah declares God will rejoice over you with gladness and rest in His love.
《哈该书》劝勉百姓省察自己的行为并专心建造圣殿。(《Hāgāishū》 quànmiǎn bǎixìng xǐngchá zìjǐ de xíngwéi bìng zhuānxīn jiànzào Shèngdiàn.) — Haggai encourages people to consider their ways and rebuild the Temple.
《撒迦利亚书》宣告不是倚靠势力，乃是倚靠神的灵方能成事。(《Sājiālìyǎshū》 xuāngào bú shì yǐkào shìlì, nǎi shì yǐkào Shén de Líng fāng néng chéng shì.) — Zechariah proclaims: Not by might nor by power, but by My Spirit.
《玛拉基书》作为旧约最后一卷书呼吁百姓悔改回归神。(《Mǎlājīshū》 zuòwéi Jiùyuē zuìhòu yì juàn shū hūyù bǎixìng huǐgǎi huíguī Shén.) — As the final Old Testament book, Malachi calls people to repentance and return to God.
《马太福音》见证耶稣是旧约应许的弥赛亚与君王。(《Mǎtài Fúyīn》 jiànzhèng Yēsū shì Jiùyuē yīngxǔ de Mísǎiyà yǔ jūnwáng.) — Matthew testifies that Jesus is the promised Messiah and King.
《马可福音》生动展现了耶稣作为仆人服事人并舍命作赎价。(《Mǎkě Fúyīn》 shēngdòng zhǎnxiàn le Yēsū zuòwéi púrén fúshì rén bìng shěmìng zuò shújià.) — Mark vividly presents Jesus serving others and giving His life as a ransom.
《路加福音》详尽记述了人子耶稣寻找拯救失丧之人的慈爱。(《Lùjiā Fúyīn》 xiángjìn jìshù le Rénzǐ Yēsū xúnzhǎo zhěngjiù shīsàng zhī rén de cí'ài.) — Luke details Jesus coming to seek and save the lost.
《约翰福音》启示了道成肉身的神子以及神爱世人的真理。(《Yuēhàn Fúyīn》 qǐshì le Dào chéng ròushēn de Shénzǐ yǐjí Shén ài shìrén de zhēnlǐ.) — John reveals the Word made flesh and the truth that God so loved the world.
《使徒行传》记录了初期教会建立与福音广传的圣灵作为。(《Shǐtú Xíngzhuàn》 jìlù le chūqī jiàohuì jiànlì yǔ fúyīn guǎngchuán de Shènglíng zuòwéi.) — Acts records the early church and the Holy Spirit’s work in spreading the gospel.

《罗马书》系统阐明了因信称义、救恩恩典与基督里的新生命。(《Luómǎshū》 xìtǒng chǎnmíng le yīn xìn chēngyì, jiù'ēn ēndiǎn yǔ Jīdū lǐ de xīn shēngmìng.) — Romans systematically expounds justification by faith, grace, and new life in Christ.
《哥林多前书》第十三章详述了爱的真谛与永不止息。(《Gēlīnduō Qiánshū》 dì shísān zhāng xiángshù le ài de zhēndì yǔ yǒng bù zhǐxī.) — 1 Corinthians 13 describes the true essence and unending nature of love.
《哥林多后书》阐述了神的恩典在人的软弱上显得完全。(《Gēlīnduō Hòushū》 chǎnshù le Shén de ēndiǎn zài rén de ruǎnruò shang xiǎnde wánquán.) — 2 Corinthians expounds that God's grace is made perfect in weakness.
《加拉太书》捍卫了福音真理与圣灵所结九样果子的生活。(《Jiālātàishū》 hànwèi le fúyīn zhēnlǐ yǔ Shènglíng suǒ jié jiǔ yàng guǒzi de shēnghuó.) — Galatians defends gospel truth and living by the fruit of the Spirit.

《以弗所书》阐明了教会荣耀的奥秘与穿戴神所赐的全副军装。(《Yǐfúsuǒshū》 chǎnmíng le jiàohuì róngyào de àomì yǔ chuāndài Shén suǒ cì de quánfù jūnzhuāng.) — Ephesians expounds the mystery of the Church and putting on the armor of God.

《腓立比书》充满了在主里常常喜乐与靠着爱我们的凡事都能作。(《Féilìbǐshū》 chōngmǎn le zài Zhǔ lǐ chángcháng xǐlè yǔ kàozhe ài wǒmen de fánshì dōu néng zuò.) — Philippians is filled with joy in the Lord and doing all things through Christ who strengthens us.
《歌罗西书》高举基督在万有中居首位与至高的荣耀。(《Gēluóxīshū》 gāojǔ Jīdū zài wànyǒu zhōng jū shǒuwèi yǔ zhìgāo de róngyào.) — Colossians exalts Christ as supreme in all creation and holding first place.

《帖撒罗尼迦前书》劝勉信徒常常喜乐、不住祷告、凡事谢恩。(《Tiēsǎluóníjiā Qiánshū》 quànmiǎn xìntú chángcháng xǐlè, búzhù dǎogào, fánshì xiè'ēn.) — 1 Thessalonians encourages believers to rejoice always, pray continually, give thanks in all circumstances.

《帖撒罗尼迦后书》坚固信徒在等候主再来时专心作正经事。(《Tiēsǎluóníjiā Hòushū》 jiāngù xìntú zài děnghòu Zhǔ zàilái shí zhuānxīn zuò zhèngjīng shì.) — 2 Thessalonians strengthens believers to stand firm while awaiting the Lord’s return.

《提摩太前书》教导年轻传道人如何治理教会与持守纯正信仰。(《Tímótài Qiánshū》 jiàodǎo niánqīng chuándàorén rúhé zhìlǐ jiàohuì yǔ chíshǒu chúnzhèng xìnyǎng.) — 1 Timothy instructs young ministers on church leadership and guarding pure faith.

《提摩太后书》勉励奔跑当跑的路、打美好的仗并持守真道。(《Tímótài Hòushū》 miǎnlì bēnpǎo dāng pǎo de lù, dǎ měihǎo de zhàng bìng chíshǒu zhēndào.) — 2 Timothy encourages fighting the good fight, finishing the race, and keeping the faith.
《提多书》指导在各地教会设立称职长老与热心行善。(《Tíduōshū》 zhǐdǎo zài gèdì jiàohuì shèlì chènzhí zhǎnglǎo yǔ rèxīn xíngshàn.) — Titus guides appointing godly elders in churches and being zealous for good works.

《腓利门书》展现了在基督里饶恕接纳与兄弟之爱的榜样。(《Féilìménshū》 zhǎnxiàn le zài Jīdū lǐ ráoshù jiēnà yǔ xiōngdì zhī ài de bǎngyàng.) — Philemon presents an example of forgiveness, reconciliation, and brotherly love in Christ.
《希伯来书》阐明了耶稣是大祭司以及信是所望之事的实底。(《Xībóláishū》 chǎnmíng le Yēsū shì Dà Jìsī yǐjí xìn shì suǒ wàng zhī shì de shídǐ.) — Hebrews expounds Jesus as High Priest and faith as confidence in what we hope for.
《雅各书》强调信心与行为并重，听道且要行道。(《Yǎgèshū》 qiángdiào xìnxīn yǔ xíngwéi bìngzhòng, tīng dào qiě yào xíng dào.) — James emphasizes faith in action—not just listening to the word, but doing what it says.
《彼得前书》勉励信徒在受苦中存活泼的盼望与圣洁的生活。(《Bǐdé Qiánshū》 miǎnlì xìntú zài shòukǔ zhōng cún huópo de pànwàng yǔ shèngjié de shēnghuó.) — 1 Peter encourages living hope and holiness amid trials and suffering.
《彼得后书》提醒防备假师傅并在恩典和知识上持续长进。(《Bǐdé Hòushū》 tíxǐng fángbèi jiǎ shīfu bìng zài ēndiǎn hé zhīshi shang chíxù zhǎngjìn.) — 2 Peter warns against false teachers and exhorts growing in grace and knowledge.
《约翰一书》见证神就是爱，住在爱里面的就是住在神里面。(《Yuēhàn Yīshū》 jiànzhèng Shén jiù shì ài, zhù zài ài lǐmiàn de jiù shì zhù zài Shén lǐmiàn.) — 1 John testifies that God is love, and whoever lives in love lives in God.
《约翰二书》勉励信徒要在真理与爱心之中行事为人。(《Yuēhàn Èrshū》 miǎnlì xìntú yào zài zhēnlǐ yǔ àixīn zhīzhōng xíngshì wéirén.) — 2 John encourages believers to walk in truth and love.

《约翰三书》祝愿凡事兴盛身体健壮正如灵魂兴盛一样。(《Yuēhàn Sānshū》 zhùyuàn fánshì xīngshèng shēntǐ jiànzhuàng zhèngrú línghún xīngshèng yíyàng.) — 3 John prays that you may enjoy good health and all go well with you, even as your soul prospers.

《犹大书》劝勉大家在至圣的真道上造就自己并在圣灵里祷告。(《Yóudàshū》 quànmiǎn dàjiā zài zhì shèng de zhēndào shang zàojiù zìjǐ bìng zài Shènglíng lǐ dǎogào.) — Jude exhorts building yourselves up in your most holy faith and praying in the Holy Spirit.

《启示录》揭示了新天新地的荣耀异象与基督最后的得胜作王。(《Qǐshìlù》 jiēshì le xīn tiān xīn dì de róngyào yìxiàng yǔ Jīdū zuìhòu de déshèng zuò wáng.) — Revelation reveals the glorious vision of new heavens, new earth, and Christ’s ultimate triumph.
我每天早上都做半个小时运动。(Wǒ měitiān zǎoshang dōu zuò bàn gè xiǎoshí yùndòng.) — I exercise for half an hour every morning.
他喜欢在公园里跑步。(Tā xǐhuan zài gōngyuán lǐ pǎobù.) — He likes jogging in the park.

meaning: to take a walk / to stroll
example: 晚饭后我们一起去散步吧。(Wǎnfàn hòu wǒmen yìqǐ qù sànbù ba.) — Let's go for a walk together after dinner.
夏天很多人喜欢去海边游泳。(Xiàtiān hěn duō rén xǐhuan qù hǎibiān yóuyǒng.) — In summer many people like to go swimming at the beach.
周末我们常去KTV唱歌。(Zhōumò wǒmen cháng qù KTV chànggē.) — We often go singing at KTV on weekends.
她在广场上跟着音乐跳舞。(Tā zài guǎngchǎng shang gēnzhe yīnyuè tiàowǔ.) — She dances along to the music in the square.
今年假期你打算去哪里旅游？(Jīnnián jiàqī nǐ dǎsuàn qù nǎlǐ lǚyóu?) — Where do you plan to travel for holiday this year?

meaning: to take photos / to snap pictures
example: 这里的风景太美了，快拍照！(Zhèlǐ de fēngjǐng tài měi le, kuài pāizhào!) — The scenery here is gorgeous, hurry take a photo!
今晚你想看什么电影？(Jīnwǎn nǐ xiǎng kàn shénme diànyǐng?) — What movie do you want to watch tonight?

meaning: to play / to hang out / to have fun
example: 周末欢迎来我家玩！(Zhōumò huānyíng lái wǒ jiā wán!) — Welcome to come over to my place to hang out this weekend!

meaning: to go online / surf the internet
example: 他在上网查学习资料。(Tā zài shàngwǎng chá xuéxí zīliào.) — He is going online to look up study materials.
我们一边喝咖啡一边聊天。(Wǒmen yìbiān hē kāfēi yìbiān liáotiān.) — We drank coffee while chatting.
我做家务时喜欢听轻音乐。(Wǒ zuò jiāwù shí xǐhuan tīng qīng yīnyuè.) — I like listening to light music when doing chores.
经常锻炼身体对健康有好处。(Jīngcháng duànliàn shēntǐ duì jiànkāng yǒu hǎochu.) — Regular exercise is good for health.

meaning: to go window shopping / stroll the streets
example: 星期六我和朋友去市中心逛街。(Xīngqīliù wǒ hé péngyou qù shìzhōngxīn guàngjiē.) — On Saturday I went window shopping downtown with friends.
今晚我们有一个老同学聚会。(Jīnwǎn wǒmen yǒu yí gè lǎo tóngxué jùhuì.) — We have a reunion party with old classmates tonight.
下午我们去体育馆打球吧。(Xiàwǔ wǒmen qù tǐyùguǎn dǎqiú ba.) — Let's go play ball at the gymnasium this afternoon.
天气好时我喜欢骑车上班。(Tiānqì hǎo shí wǒ xǐhuan qíchē shàngbān.) — When the weather is nice I like riding a bike to work.

meaning: to climb a mountain / to hike
example: 秋天是去郊外爬山的好季节。(Qiūtiān shì qù jiāowài páshān de hǎo jìjié.) — Autumn is a great season to hike in the countryside.
你的主要业余爱好是什么？(Nǐ de zhǔyào yèyú àihào shì shénme?) — What is your main hobby in your spare time?
听音乐能帮我放松心情。(Tīng yīnyuè néng bāng wǒ fàngsōng xīnqíng.) — Listening to music helps me relax.
早睡早起是一个好习惯。(Zǎoshuì zǎoqǐ shì yí gè hǎo xíguàn.) — Sleeping early and getting up early is a good habit.
祝你周末过得愉快！(Zhù nǐ zhōumò guò de yúkuài!) — Wish you a pleasant weekend!
毕业后你有什么打算？(Bìyè hòu nǐ yǒu shénme dǎsuan?) — What are your plans after graduation?
他经常去图书馆借书。(Tā jīngcháng qù túshūguǎn jiè shū.) — He often goes to the library to borrow books.
他们在市中心买了一套新房子。(Tāmen zài shìzhōngxīn mǎi le yí tào xīn fángzi.) — They bought a new apartment downtown.
我想在公司附近租一间公寓。(Wǒ xiǎng zài gōngsī fùjìn zū yì jiān gōngyù.) — I want to rent an apartment near the company.
每个月五号必须交房租。(Měi gè yuè wǔ hào bìxū jiāo fángzū.) — Rent must be paid on the 5th of each month.
厨房里有很多新鲜蔬菜。(Chúfáng lǐ yǒu hěn duō xīnxiān shūcài.) — There are lots of fresh vegetables in the kitchen.
请问，卫生间在哪里？(Qǐngwèn, wèishēngjiān zài nǎlǐ?) — Excuse me, where is the restroom?
客人正在客厅里喝茶聊天。(Kèrén zhèngzài kètīng lǐ hē chá liáotiān.) — The guests are drinking tea and chatting in the living room.
我的卧室朝南，采光很好。(Wǒ de wòshì cháo nán, cǎiguāng hěn hǎo.) — My bedroom faces south, so it gets great natural light.
阳台上种满了漂亮的花草。(Yángtái shang zhòng mǎn le piàoliang de huācǎo.) — The balcony is filled with beautiful flowers and plants.
出门前别忘了带门钥匙。(Chūmén qián bié wàng le dài mén yàoshi.) — Don't forget to take the door key before going out.
你锁好大门了吗？(Nǐ suǒ hǎo dàmén le ma?) — Did you lock the front door?
离开房间请随手关灯。(Líkāi fángjiān qǐng suíshǒu guān dēng.) — Please turn off the light when leaving the room.
天气太热了，把空调打开吧。(Tiānqì tài rè le, bǎ kōngtiáo dǎkāi ba.) — It's too hot, let's turn on the air conditioner.
冰箱里有冰水和新鲜水果。(Bīngxiāng lǐ yǒu bīngshuǐ hé xīnxiān shuǐguǒ.) — There is ice water and fresh fruit in the fridge.
脏衣服已经放进洗衣机了。(Zāng yīfu yǐjīng fàng jìn xǐyījī le.) — The dirty clothes have been put in the washing machine.
洗澡前先开一下热水器。(Xǐzǎo qián xiān kāi yíxià rèshuǐqì.) — Turn on the water heater before taking a shower.
下楼的时候顺便把垃圾扔了。(Xiàlóu de shíhou shùnbiàn bǎ lājī rēng le.) — Take out the trash when you go downstairs.
书桌旁边有一个小垃圾桶。(Shūzhuō pángbiān yǒu yí gè xiǎo lājītǒng.) — There is a small trash bin next to the desk.
我们每个周末都打扫房间。(Wǒmen měi gè zhōumò dōu dǎsǎo fángjiān.) — We clean the apartment every weekend.
我下个月搬家到新小区。(Wǒ xià gè yuè bānjiā dào xīn xiǎoqū.) — I'm moving to a new residential community next month.
隔壁邻居为人非常热情友好。(Gébì línjū wéirén fēicháng rèqíng yǒuhǎo.) — The next-door neighbor is very warm and friendly.
我们坐电梯上八楼。(Wǒmen zuò diàntī shàng bā lóu.) — Let's take the elevator up to the 8th floor.
走楼梯对身体锻炼很有帮助。(Zǒu lóutī duì shēntǐ duànliàn hěn yǒu bāngzhù.) — Taking the stairs is great exercise for the body.
浴室的水龙头坏了，正在漏水。(Yùshì de shuǐlóngtóu huài le, zhèngzài lòushuǐ.) — The bathroom faucet is broken and leaking.
请师傅今天下午来修空调。(Qǐng shīfu jīntiān xiàwǔ lái xiū kōngtiáo.) — Please have the technician come fix the air conditioner this afternoon.
这个小区环境非常安静舒适。(Zhè ge xiǎoqū huánjìng fēicháng ānjìng shūshì.) — This neighborhood environment is very quiet and comfortable.

meaning: to go to work / on duty
example: 我每天早上八点半准时上班。(Wǒ měitiān zǎoshang bā diǎn bàn zhǔnshí shàngbān.) — I go to work punctually at 8:30 every morning.

meaning: to get off work / off duty
example: 今天下班后你有空一起吃饭吗？(Jīntiān xiàbān hòu nǐ yǒu kòng yìqǐ chīfàn ma?) — Do you have time to eat together after work today?
为了赶进度，我们今晚需要加班。(Wèile gǎn jìndù, wǒmen jīnwǎn xūyào jiābān.) — To catch up on progress, we need to work overtime tonight.

meaning: to hold a meeting / to attend a meeting
example: 下午两点全体员工在大会议室开会。(Xiàwǔ liǎng diǎn quántǐ yuángōng zài dà huìyìshì kāihuì.) — All staff will meet in the main conference room at 2 PM.
张经理正在和新客户谈合作。(Zhāng jīnglǐ zhèngzài hé xīn kèhù tán hézuò.) — Manager Zhang is discussing cooperation with a new client.
我和同事们相处得非常融洽。(Wǒ hé tóngshìmen xiāngchǔ de fēicháng róngqià.) — I get along very well with my colleagues.
老板同意了我们提出的新方案。(Lǎobǎn tóngyì le wǒmen tíchū de xīn fāng'àn.) — The boss approved our new proposal.
李总在三楼的办公室等你。(Lǐ zǒng zài sān lóu de bàngōngshì děng nǐ.) — Director Li is waiting for you in the office on the 3rd floor.
我已经给你发邮件了，请查收项目合同。(Wǒ yǐjīng gěi nǐ fā yóujiàn le, qǐng cháshōu xiàngmù hétong.) — I have already sent you an email, please check the project contract.
请帮我打印三份开会材料。(Qǐng bāng wǒ dǎyìn sān fèn kāihuì cáiliào.) — Please help me print three copies of the meeting materials.
大家都在认真准备明天的演讲。(Dàjiā dōu zài rènzhēn zhǔnbèi míngtiān de yǎnjiǎng.) — Everyone is diligently preparing for tomorrow's presentation.
这项任务必须在周五前完成。(Zhè xiàng rènwu bìxū zài zhōuwǔ qián wánchéng.) — This task must be completed before Friday.
他负责市场部的产品推广。(Tā fùzé shìchǎngbù de chǎnpǐn tuīguǎng.) — He is in charge of product promotion in marketing.
我们团队正在做一个新软件项目。(Wǒmen tuánduì zhèngzài zuò yí gè xīn ruǎnjiàn xiàngmù.) — Our team is working on a new software project.
我已经写好了上个月的财务报告。(Wǒ yǐjīng xiě hǎo le shàng gè yuè de cáiwù bàogào.) — I have finished writing last month's financial report.

meaning: to ask for leave / time off
example: 我需要请假，因为我生病了。(Wǒ xūyào qǐngjià, yīnwèi wǒ shēngbìng le.) — I need to ask for leave because I'm sick.
因为堵车，今天早上我迟到了。(Yīnwèi dǔchē, jīntiān zǎoshang wǒ chídào le.) — Because of traffic, I arrived late this morning.
公司每个月十号发工资。(Gōngsī měi gè yuè shí hào fā gōngzī.) — The company pays salaries on the 10th of every month.
他明天下午有一场重要面试。(Tā míngtiān xiàwǔ yǒu yì chǎng zhòngyào miànshì.) — He has an important interview tomorrow afternoon.
大家对这个方案还有什么问题吗？(Dàjiā duì zhè ge fāng'àn hái yǒu shénme wèntí ma?) — Does anyone have any questions about this plan?

meaning: to resolve / to settle / to solve
example: 技术团队很快解决了系统故障。(Jìshù tuánduì hěn kuài jiějué le xìtǒng gùzhàng.) — The tech team resolved the system fault very quickly.
非常高兴能与贵公司合作！(Fēicháng gāoxìng néng yǔ guì gōngsī hézuò!) — Very glad to cooperate with your esteemed company!
我们下周再仔细讨论这个细节。(Wǒmen xià zhōu zài zǐxì tǎolùn zhè ge xìjié.) — Let's discuss this detail carefully next week.
我和大家的意见一致，完全同意。(Wǒ hé dàjiā de yìjiàn yízhì, wánquán tóngyì.) — My opinion matches everyone's, I completely agree.
他在国际贸易方面有丰富经验。(Tā zài guójì màoyì fāngmiàn yǒu fēngfù jīngyàn.) — He has rich experience in international trade.
服务员，请给我们一份菜单。(Fúwùyuán, qǐng gěi wǒmen yí fèn càidān.) — Waiter, please give us a menu.
这家餐厅的服务态度非常好。(Zhè jiā cāntīng de fúwù tàidu fēicháng hǎo.) — The service attitude at this restaurant is very good.
请问你们店有什么特色菜推荐吗？(Qǐngwèn nǐmen diàn yǒu shénme tèsè cài tuījiàn ma?) — Could you recommend your restaurant's specialty dishes?
这道麻婆豆腐的味道很正宗。(Zhè dào mápó dòufu de wèidao hěn zhèngzōng.) — The flavor of this Mapo Tofu is very authentic.
我不太能吃辣，请少放辣椒。(Wǒ bú tài néng chī là, qǐng shǎo fàng làjiāo.) — I can't eat very spicy food, please put less chili.
这个西瓜又大又甜。(Zhè ge xīguā yòu dà yòu tián.) — This watermelon is both big and sweet.
酸辣汤酸酸辣辣的，很好喝。(Suānlàtāng suānsuān làlà de, hěn hǎohē.) — The hot and sour soup is pleasantly tangy and spicy, very tasty.
良药苦口利于病。(Liáng yào kǔ kǒu lì yú bìng.) — Good medicine tastes bitter but benefits health.
这个菜稍微有点咸，少放点盐吧。(Zhè ge cài shāowēi yǒudiǎn xián, shǎo fàng diǎn yán ba.) — This dish is slightly salty, put a bit less salt.
生病时饮食最好清淡一点。(Shēngbìng shí yǐnshí zuìhǎo qīngdàn yìdiǎn.) — When sick, it's best to eat lighter, milder food.
炸鸡吃多了会觉得油腻。(Zhájī chī duō le huì juéde yóunì.) — Eating too much fried chicken feels greasy.

meaning: to boil / to cook in water
example: 水开了，可以煮水饺了。(Shuǐ kāi le, kěyǐ zhǔ shuǐjiǎo le.) — The water is boiling, we can cook the dumplings now.
西红柿炒鸡蛋是经典中国菜。(Xīhóngshì chǎo jīdàn shì jīngdiǎn Zhōngguó cài.) — Tomato scrambled eggs is a classic Chinese dish.

meaning: to roast / to bake / to barbecue
example: 北京烤鸭在全世界都很出名。(Běijīng kǎoyā zài quán shìjiè dōu hěn chūmíng.) — Beijing roast duck is famous worldwide.
刚炸好的油条外脆内软。(Gāng zhá hǎo de yóutiáo wài cuì nèi ruǎn.) — Freshly fried dough sticks are crispy outside and soft inside.

meaning: to cut / to slice / to chop
example: 请把牛肉切成细丝。(Qǐng bǎ niúròu qiē chéng xì sī.) — Please slice the beef into thin shreds.
饭前喝一碗热汤对胃好。(Fàn qián hē yì wǎn rè tāng duì wèi hǎo.) — Having a bowl of hot soup before meals is good for digestion.
炒青菜时放一点点盐就够了。(Chǎo qīngcài shí fàng yìdiǎndiǎn yán jiù gòu le.) — Adding just a little salt is enough when stir-frying greens.
喝咖啡你习惯加糖和牛奶吗？(Hē kāfēi nǐ xíguàn jiā táng hé niúnǎi ma?) — Do you usually add sugar and milk to your coffee?
吃饺子蘸点香醋特别香。(Chī jiǎozi zhàn diǎn xiāngcù tèbié xiāng.) — Dipping dumplings in aromatic vinegar is especially delicious.
红烧肉需要加入生抽和老抽酱油。(Hóngshāoròu xūyào jiārù shēngchōu hé lǎochōu jiàngyóu.) — Braised pork requires light and dark soy sauce.

meaning: takeout / to pack food to go
example: 服务员，剩下的菜请帮我们打包。(Fúwùyuán, shèngxià de cài qǐng bāng wǒmen dǎbāo.) — Waiter, please help us pack the remaining food to go.
这家海鲜店的鱼虾都很新鲜。(Zhè jiā hǎixiān diàn de yú xiā dōu hěn xīnxiān.) — The fish and shrimp at this seafood shop are very fresh.
今天吃得太饱了，吃不下了。(Jīntiān chī de tài bǎo le, chī bú xià le.) — I am so full today, I can't eat any more.

meaning: to treat someone (to a meal) / my treat
example: 今天我发奖金，我请客！(Jīntiān wǒ fā jiǎngjīn, wǒ qǐngkè!) — I got my bonus today, it's my treat!
这附近有便利店或者超市吗？(Zhè fùjìn yǒu biànlìdiàn huòzhě chāoshì ma?) — Is there a convenience store or supermarket nearby?
银行就在那家咖啡馆旁边。(Yínháng jiù zài nà jiā kāfēiguǎn pángbiān.) — The bank is right beside that cafe.
马路对面有一座大商场。(Mǎlù duìmiàn yǒu yí zuò dà shāngchǎng.) — Across the street there is a large shopping mall.
书店位于邮局和银行中间。(Shūdiàn wèiyú yóujú hé yínháng zhōngjiān.) — The bookstore is situated between the post office and the bank.
在前面的十字路口向左拐。(Zài qiánmiàn de shízì lùkǒu xiàng zuǒ guǎi.) — Turn left at the intersection ahead.
过马路一定要看红绿灯。(Guò mǎlù yídìng yào kàn hónglǜdēng.) — Always watch the traffic light when crossing the road.

meaning: to turn a corner / make a turn
example: 走到路口右拐弯就到了。(Zǒu dào lùkǒu yòu guǎiwān jiù dào le.) — Walk to the intersection, turn right, and you're there.

meaning: to go straight / walk straight ahead
example: 一直往前直走两百米。(Yìzhí wǎng qián zhí zǒu liǎng bǎi mǐ.) — Keep walking straight ahead for 200 meters.
师傅，请在前面的路口停一下。(Shīfu, qǐng zài qiánmiàn de lùkǒu tíng yíxià.) — Driver, please pull over at the intersection ahead.
地下二层有大型收费停车场。(Dìxià èr céng yǒu dàxíng shòufèi tíngchēchǎng.) — There is a large paid parking lot on basement level 2.
我打开电子地图查一下路线。(Wǒ dǎkāi diànzǐ dìtú chá yíxià lùxiàn.) — I'll open the electronic map to check the route.
跟着手机导航走就不会迷路。(Gēnzhe shǒujī dǎoháng zǒu jiù bú huì mílù.) — Follow the phone GPS and you won't get lost.

meaning: to get lost / lose one's way
example: 我在这个陌生的城市迷路了。(Wǒ zài zhè ge mòshēng de chéngshì mílù le.) — I got lost in this unfamiliar city.
老人们在公园里打太极拳。(Lǎorénmen zài gōngyuán lǐ dǎ tàijíquán.) — The seniors are practicing Tai Chi in the park.
我想去中国银行换一点外币。(Wǒ xiǎng qù Zhōngguó Yínháng huàn yìdiǎn wàibì.) — I want to go to Bank of China to exchange some foreign currency.
邮局就在马路拐角处。(Yóujú jiù zài mǎlù guǎijiǎo chù.) — The post office is right at the street corner.
去药店买一盒止痛药。(Qù yàodiàn mǎi yì hé zhǐtòngyào.) — Go to the pharmacy to buy a box of painkillers.
车快没油了，找个加油站吧。(Chē kuài méi yóu le, zhǎo gè jiāyóuzhàn ba.) — The car is running low on gas, let's find a gas station.
过了这座大桥就是火车站。(Guò le zhè zuò dàqiáo jiù shì huǒchēzhàn.) — After crossing this big bridge is the train station.
从这里到机场的距离大概三十公里。(Cóng zhèlǐ dào jīchǎng de jùlí dàgài sānshí gōnglǐ.) — The distance from here to the airport is about 30 km.
住在这里坐地铁非常方便。(Zhù zài zhèlǐ zuò dìtiě fēicháng fāngbiàn.) — Living here makes taking the subway very convenient.
下班高峰期路上很容易堵车。(Xiàbān gāofēngqī lùshang hěn róngyì dǔchē.) — During the evening rush hour it gets traffic jammed easily.
我们在地铁站C出口见面吧。(Wǒmen zài dìtiězhàn C chūkǒu jiànmiàn ba.) — Let's meet at subway station Exit C.
商场主入口在东侧街道。(Shāngchǎng zhǔ rùkǒu zài dōng cè jiēdào.) — The mall's main entrance is on the east street.
这条道路正在进行维修施工。(Zhè tiáo dàolù zhèngzài jìnxíng wéixiū shīgōng.) — This road is currently undergoing repair work.
请扫码点餐和付款。(Qǐng sǎomǎ diǎncān hé fùkuǎn.) — Please scan the QR code to order and pay.
请出示您的付款二维码。(Qǐng chūshì nín de fùkuǎn èrwéimǎ.) — Please show your payment QR code.
在中国移动支付非常普及。(Zài Zhōngguó yídòng zhīfù fēicháng pǔjí.) — In China mobile payment is extremely widespread.
我们加一下微信，方便以后联系。(Wǒmen jiā yíxià Wēixìn, fāngbiàn yǐhòu liánxì.) — Let's add each other on WeChat for easy contact.

meaning: to swipe a card / pay by card
example: 这里可以刷卡付款吗？(Zhèlǐ kěyǐ shuākǎ fùkuǎn ma?) — Can I pay by card here?
我的交通卡没钱了，需要去充值。(Wǒ de jiāotōng kǎ méi qián le, xūyào qù chōngzhí.) — My transit card is out of money, I need to top it up.
请输入您的登录账号和密码。(Qǐng shūrù nín de dēnglù zhànghào hé mìmǎ.) — Please enter your login account and password.
请不要把银行卡密码告诉别人。(Qǐng bú yào bǎ yínhángkǎ mìmǎ gàosu biérén.) — Please do not disclose your bank card password to others.
你可以在应用商店免费下载这个软件。(Nǐ kěyǐ zài yìngyòng shāngdiàn miǎnfèi xiàzài zhè ge ruǎnjiàn.) — You can download this app for free in the app store.
消息已经成功发送出去了。(Xiāoxi yǐjīng chénggōng fāsòng chūqu le.) — The message has been sent successfully.
手机正在接收最新的系统更新。(Shǒujī zhèngzài jiēshōu zuìxīn de xìtǒng gēngxīn.) — The phone is receiving the latest system update.
这个学中文的软件很好用。(Zhè ge xué Zhōngwén de ruǎnjiàn hěn hǎoyòng.) — This Chinese learning app is very useful.
电梯里面手机一点信号都没有。(Diàntī lǐmiàn shǒujī yìdiǎn xìnhào dōu méiyǒu.) — There is no phone signal at all inside the elevator.
这里的网络连接速度非常快。(Zhèlǐ de wǎngluò liánjiē sùdù fēicháng kuài.) — The internet connection speed here is very fast.
手机电池只剩百分之十了。(Shǒujī diànchí zhǐ shèng bǎifēnzhī shí le.) — The phone battery only has 10% left.
我得给手机充电了。(Wǒ děi gěi shǒujī chōngdiàn le.) — I need to charge my phone.
饭馆门口可以租借共享充电宝。(Fànguǎn ménkǒu kěyǐ zūjiè gòngxiǎng chōngdiànbǎo.) — You can rent a shared power bank at the restaurant entrance.
这台平板电脑的屏幕很清晰。(Zhè tái píngbǎn diànnǎo de píngmù hěn qīngxī.) — The screen of this tablet is very clear.
今晚我们和父母视频通话吧。(Jīnwǎn wǒmen hé fùmǔ shìpín tōnghuà ba.) — Let's do a video call with our parents tonight.
打字不方便的时候可以发语音。(Dǎzì bù fāngbiàn de shíhou kěyǐ fā yǔyīn.) — You can send voice messages when typing is inconvenient.
系统刚给你的手机发了验证码。(Xìtǒng gāng gěi nǐ de shǒujī fā le yànzhèngmǎ.) — The system just sent a verification code to your phone.
看到消息后请尽快给我回复。(Kàndào xiāoxi hòu qǐng jǐnkuài gěi wǒ huífù.) — Please reply to me as soon as you see the message.

meaning: to follow (social media) / pay attention to
example: 欢迎关注我们的官方公众号！(Huānyíng guānzhù wǒmen de guānfāng gōngzhònghào!) — Welcome to follow our official public account!
你在搜索引擎上查查这篇论文。(Nǐ zài sōusuǒ yǐnqíng shang chácha zhè piān lùnwén.) — Search for this paper on the search engine.
现代人越来越喜欢在家里网购。(Xiàndàirén yuèláiyuè xǐhuan zài jiālǐ wǎnggòu.) — Modern people increasingly like shopping online from home.
真的吗？太令人惊喜了！(Zhēn de ma? Tài lìngrén jīngxǐ le!) — Really? That is so wonderful and surprising!
当然可以，随时欢迎你来！(Dāngrán kěyǐ, suíshí huānyíng nǐ lái!) — Of course, you are welcome to come anytime!
包在我身上，没问题！(Bāo zài wǒ shēnshang, méi wèntí!) — Leave it to me, no problem!

meaning: forget it / let it go / drop it
example: 既然下雨了，算了吧，改天再去。(Jìrán xiàyǔ le, suàn le ba, gǎitiān zài qù.) — Since it's raining, let it go, we'll go another day.
中午吃什么？我都行，随便你。(Zhōngwǔ chī shénme? Wǒ dōu xíng, suíbiàn nǐ.) — What to eat for lunch? I'm good with anything, up to you.
麻烦您帮我递一下那本书。(Máfan nín bāng wǒ dì yíxià nà běn shū.) — Trouble you to pass me that book, please.

meaning: excuse me / sorry to bother / embarrassed
example: 不好意思，借过一下。(Bù hǎoyìsi, jièguò yíxià.) — Excuse me, pardon me coming through.
你放心，我一定会按时把事情办好。(Nǐ fàngxīn, wǒ yídìng huì ànshí bǎ shìqing bàn hǎo.) — Rest assured, I will definitely get it done on time.

meaning: keep it up! / cheer on! / go for it!
example: 考试别紧张，加油！(Kǎoshì bié jǐnzhāng, jiāyóu!) — Don't be nervous about the exam, cheer up and do your best!
恭喜你顺利通过了汉语水平考试！(Gōngxǐ nǐ shùnlì tōngguò le Hànyǔ Shuǐpíng Kǎoshì!) — Congratulations on successfully passing the HSK exam!

meaning: thank you for your hard work / you've worked hard
example: 今天大家辛苦了，早点回家休息吧。(Jīntiān dàjiā xīnkǔ le, zǎodiǎn huíjiā xiūxi ba.) — Thank you everyone for your hard work today, go home early and rest.
学中文不用着急，慢慢来。(Xué Zhōngwén bú yòng zháojí, mànman lái.) — No need to rush learning Chinese, take your time.
你脸色不太好，怎么了？(Nǐ liǎnsè bú tài hǎo, zěnme le?) — You don't look well, what's the matter?

meaning: to joke / to make fun of / just kidding
example: 别当真，我只是跟你开玩笑。(Bié dàngzhēn, wǒ zhǐshì gēn nǐ kāiwánxiào.) — Don't take it seriously, I was just kidding with you.
你的中文说得太厉害了！(Nǐ de Zhōngwén shuō de tài lìhai le!) — Your spoken Chinese is truly impressive!
这部电影拍得确实非常感人。(Zhè bù diànyǐng pāi de quèshí fēicháng gǎnrén.) — This movie was indeed filmed very touchingly.
我的工作差不多全部做完了。(Wǒ de gōngzuò chàbuduō quánbù zuò wán le.) — My work is almost completely done.
原来是你啊，我还以为是谁呢！(Yuánlái shì nǐ a, wǒ hái yǐwéi shì shéi ne!) — So it was you! I was wondering who it was!
其实学汉字并没有想象中那么难。(Qíshí xué hànzì bìng méiyǒu xiǎngxiàng zhōng nàme nán.) — Actually learning characters isn't as hard as imagined.
另外，请记得明天带上护照复印件。(Lìngwài, qǐng jìde míngtiān dài shàng hùzhào fùyìnjiàn.) — In addition, please remember to bring a passport copy tomorrow.
外面突然下起了大雨。(Wàimiàn tūrán xià qǐ le dàyǔ.) — Suddenly it started pouring rain outside.
经过努力，我们终于完成了任务。(Jīngguò nǔlì, wǒmen zhōngyú wánchéng le rènwu.) — Through hard work, we finally accomplished the mission.

meaning: conveniently / in passing / by the way
example: 你去超市时顺便帮我买瓶牛奶吧。(Nǐ qù chāoshì shí shùnbiàn bāng wǒ mǎi píng niúnǎi ba.) — When you go to the store, grab me a bottle of milk while you're at it.

meaning: no matter what / in any case
example: 无论如何，我们都要试一试。(Wúlùn rúhé, wǒmen dōu yào shì yí shì.) — No matter what, we must give it a try.

meaning: make yourself at home / sit wherever you like
example: 快请进，家里有点乱，随便坐！(Kuài qǐng jìn, jiālǐ yǒudiǎn luàn, suíbiàn zuò!) — Please come in, house is a bit messy, have a seat anywhere!
请出示您的护照和登机牌。(Qǐng chūshì nín de hùzhào hé dēngjīpái.) — Please show your passport and boarding pass.
去国外旅游需要提前办理签证。(Qù guówài lǚyóu xūyào tíqián bànlǐ qiānzhèng.) — Traveling abroad requires applying for a visa in advance.
先生，请问您有几件托运行李？(Xiānsheng, qǐngwèn nín yǒu jǐ jiàn tuōyùn xíngli?) — Sir, how many pieces of checked luggage do you have?
我的行李箱子装得满满的。(Wǒ de xíngli xiāngzi zhuāng de mǎnmǎn de.) — My suitcase is packed full.
我已经网上预订了三晚的酒店。(Wǒ yǐjīng wǎngshang yùdìng le sān wǎn de jiǔdiàn.) — I've already booked three nights at the hotel online.
这家五星级酒店环境很优雅。(Zhè jiā wǔxīngjí jiǔdiàn huánjìng hěn yōuyǎ.) — The environment of this five-star hotel is very elegant.
你好，我来办理入住手续。(Nǐ hǎo, wǒ lái bànlǐ rùzhù shǒuxù.) — Hello, I am here to process my check-in.
酒店规定中午十二点前退房。(Jiǔdiàn guīdìng zhōngwǔ shí'èr diǎn qián tuìfáng.) — The hotel policy requires checking out before 12:00 noon.
我想订一间安静的单人房。(Wǒ xiǎng dìng yì jiān ānjìng de dānrénfáng.) — I'd like to reserve a quiet single room.
我们两个人要一间双人房。(Wǒmen liǎng gè rén yào yì jiān shuāngrénfáng.) — The two of us want a double room.
故宫博物院的门票需要提前预约。(Gùgōng Bówùyuàn de ménpiào xūyào tíqián yùyuē.) — Palace Museum tickets require advance reservation.
长城是北京最著名的旅游景点。(Chángchéng shì Běijīng zuì zhùmíng de lǚyóu jǐngdiǎn.) — The Great Wall is Beijing's most famous attraction.
导游正在给游客讲解古建筑历史。(Dǎoyóu zhèngzài gěi yóukè jiǎngjiě gǔ jiànzhù lìshǐ.) — The tour guide is explaining the ancient architecture history.
我买了很有中国特色的小纪念品。(Wǒ mǎi le hěn yǒu Zhōngguó tèsè de xiǎo jìniànpǐn.) — I bought some souvenirs with Chinese characteristics.
飞往上海的航班将于半小时后起飞。(Fēiwǎng Shànghǎi de hángbān jiāng yú bàn xiǎoshí hòu qǐfēi.) — The flight to Shanghai will depart in half an hour.
请在自助机器上打印您的登机牌。(Qǐng zài zìzhù jīqì shang dǎyìn nín de dēngjīpái.) — Please print your boarding pass at the self-service kiosk.
过安检时请把电脑和液体拿出来。(Guò ānjiǎn shí qǐng bǎ diànnǎo hé yètǐ ná chūlái.) — When passing security, please take out laptops and liquids.
由于天气原因，列车延误了半小时。(Yóuyú tiānqì yuányīn, lièchē yánwù le bàn xiǎoshí.) — Due to weather conditions, the train is delayed 30 minutes.
飞机非常准时地降落在北京机场。(Fēijī fēicháng zhǔnshí de jiàngluò zài Běijīng jīchǎng.) — The airplane landed punctually at Beijing airport.
山顶上的自然风景美丽极了。(Shāndǐng shang de zìrán fēngjǐng měilì jí le.) — The natural scenery at the mountain top is magnificent.
您可以去游客咨询中心询问路线。(Nín kěyǐ qù yóukè zīxún zhōngxīn xúnwèn lùxiàn.) — You can inquire about routes at the tourist information center.
导游建议我们早上八点出发。(Dǎoyóu jiànyì wǒmen zǎoshang bā diǎn chūfā.) — The tour guide suggested we depart at 8:00 AM.
祝您在中国度过一段愉快的时光！(Zhù nín zài Zhōngguó dùguò yí duàn yúkuài de shíguāng!) — Wish you a wonderful time in China!
